title: Blacklist appeal — Niko
signin.title: Sign in to appeal.
signin.bodyGuild: Sign in with a Discord account that can manage this server to appeal its blacklist.
signin.bodyUser: Sign in with the Discord account that was blacklisted. Appeals are linked to your verified account.
signin.unavailable: Discord sign-in isn’t available right now.
status.pending.title: Appeal under review
status.pending.body: Your appeal has been sent to the Niko owner and Head Admins. You can check back here for the decision.
status.denied.title: Appeal denied
status.denied.body: This decision is final. A new appeal cannot be submitted for this blacklist.
status.approved.title: Appeal approved
status.approved.body: Your blacklist appeal was approved. The historical record remains on file if the account is blacklisted again.
status.notBlacklisted.title: No active blacklist
status.notBlacklisted.body: This Discord account does not currently have an active blacklist to appeal.
status.notBlacklisted.bodyGuild: This server does not currently have an active blacklist to appeal.
status.notEligible.title: This guild cannot appeal
status.notEligible.body: This blacklist is not currently eligible for an appeal.
status.eligible.title: Make your case
status.eligible.body: Explain why you believe the blacklist should be reviewed. This request goes directly to Niko staff — no support server join is needed.
form.label: Your appeal
form.placeholder: Share relevant context and why you’re requesting a review…
form.privacyGuild: Your submission and server ID are visible only to authorized staff.
form.privacyUser: Your submission and account ID are visible only to authorized staff.
support: Need another kind of help? Visit support
footer: Appeals are reviewed by the bot owner and Head Admins.
error.submit: Your appeal could not be submitted.
